news.headline: Fashion startup Atorie raises $9.5M to bring consumers luxury goods without the markup
news.summary: Atorie is cutting out the middleman in luxury fashion. The startup lets consumers buy handbags and clothes made from identical materials and factories as high-end brands—just without the designer markup.

news.headline: Z.ai shares surge 8% after releasing new AI model running only on Chinese chips
news.summary: Z.ai's stock jumped 8% after unveiling an AI model built exclusively on Chinese semiconductors—a move that signals progress toward reducing dependence on Western chip restrictions. The company quietly rolled out the model globally a week prior, now going public with the milestone.

educational.title: How a Stock Split Actually Works
points: A stock split divides each share into multiple shares — e.g. 1 becomes 4
Your total investment value doesn't change, just the share count and price
Companies split shares to make each one look more affordable to new buyers
It's a cosmetic change, not a sign the company suddenly became more valuable
Reverse splits do the opposite — often a red flag, not a good one
